verdict.rationale: Netlify documents event-driven automation: auto-deploy on every push with preview URLs, a REST API pitched as "ideal for automating workflows," serverless functions, and dashboard-launched AI agents that fix, update, and ship code. A community user confirms that automated builds and deploys work well. However, nothing shows user-defined background automations or agents that run autonomously on a schedule or trigger beyond deploys, so the agentic part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: scheduled or background functions, user-configurable autonomous agent automations that run unattended, independent hands-on evidence of the AI agent feature running in the background.
